news.headline: Pineiro continues to see the majority of his action handling extra-point duties, as he's now attempted just two field go
news.detail: Pineiro continues to see the majority of his action handling extra-point duties, as he's now attempted just two field goals across his last three outings and only 10 total on the season. Sunday's performance also marked just the second time this season that the 31-year-old didn't miss a kick.
